intro: 12 個會議情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

words.zh: 容納;提供(住宿、需要的東西)

ex.en: The conference center can accommodate up to 500 attendees.
ex.zh: 這個會議中心最多可容納 500 位與會者。

ex.en: The hotel was fully booked and could not accommodate our late request.
ex.zh: 飯店已經客滿,無法容納我們臨時的需求。

ex.en: All travel arrangements for the speakers were handled by the events team.
ex.zh: 講者的所有交通安排都由活動團隊處理。

ex.en: The seating arrangement was designed to encourage networking.
ex.zh: 座位安排的設計是為了促進人脈交流。

note: make arrangements for 為⋯做安排

ex.en: Membership in the trade association gives access to exclusive events.
ex.zh: 加入該貿易協會可以參加專屬活動。

ex.en: Her long association with the organizing committee made the process smooth.
ex.zh: 她與籌辦委員會長期的合作關係讓流程進行得很順利。

note: 課本標注「聯想」是另一常見意思,如 in association with 與⋯合作

ex.en: More than 300 delegates are expected to attend the opening session.
ex.zh: 預計超過三百位代表會參加開幕場次。

ex.en: Staff attended to every request from VIP guests.
ex.zh: 工作人員照料了貴賓的每一項需求。

note: attend a meeting(參加,及物);attend to sb./sth.(照料,不及物)

ex.en: Please get in touch with the front desk if you need extra chairs.
ex.zh: 如果需要額外的椅子,請聯繫櫃檯。

ex.en: Attendees can get in touch with speakers during the networking break.
ex.zh: 與會者可以在交流時段與講者聯繫。

ex.en: The main hall holds up to 1,000 people.
ex.zh: 主廳最多可容納一千人。

ex.en: The association holds this conference every spring.
ex.zh: 該協會每年春天舉辦這場會議。

note: hold a meeting/conference/seminar 舉行會議

ex.en: The location of next year's conference has not yet been announced.
ex.zh: 明年會議的地點尚未公布。

ex.en: A downtown location makes it easier for attendees to reach by public transit.
ex.zh: 市中心的地點讓與會者更容易搭乘大眾運輸抵達。

ex.en: The lobby became overcrowded during the morning registration period.
ex.zh: 早上報到時段大廳變得過於擁擠。

ex.en: Organizers added a second session to avoid an overcrowded room.
ex.zh: 主辦單位加開第二場以避免場地過於擁擠。

note: crowd(v./n.) 群眾、擠滿;crowded 擁擠的

ex.en: According to the register, over 400 people signed in for the keynote.
ex.zh: 根據登記名冊,有超過四百人為主題演講簽到。

ex.en: All attendees must register online before the conference date.
ex.zh: 所有與會者必須在會議日期前完成線上登記。

ex.en: Participants can select up to three workshops to attend.
ex.zh: 參加者最多可以選擇三場工作坊參加。

ex.en: Only a select group of members were invited to the VIP dinner.
ex.zh: 只有一小群精選的會員受邀參加貴賓晚宴。

note: selection 選擇、精選;selective 挑剔的、有選擇性的

ex.en: The afternoon session covers digital marketing strategies.
ex.zh: 下午場次涵蓋數位行銷策略。

ex.en: Due to high demand, the workshop will be offered in two sessions.
ex.zh: 由於需求量大,這場工作坊將分兩個場次舉行。

ex.en: Over 100 companies took part in this year's trade conference.
ex.zh: 今年有超過一百家公司參與這場貿易會議。

ex.en: Attendees are encouraged to take part in the panel discussion.
ex.zh: 鼓勵與會者參與座談討論。
